question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited which neighboring country in November 2025 with a focus on Hydropower and Digital cooperation under the 'Neighborhood First' policy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhutan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi undertook a two-day official visit to Bhutan starting November 11, 2025, to strengthen the bilateral partnership under India’s Neighborhood First policy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **During the visit, Prime Minister Modi and King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck inaugurated the 1,020-megawatt Punatsangchhu-II Hydroelectric Project, which was jointly developed by the two nations.**
 
• **The Prime Minister participated in the celebrations of the 70th birth anniversary of the Fourth King of Bhutan, Jigme Singye Wangchuck, highlighting the deep-rooted respect between the leadership.**
 
• **Strategic discussions were held with Bhutanese Prime Minister Tshering Tobgay to deliberate on ways to enhance cooperation in hydropower, digital connectivity, and regional security.**
 
• **Prime Minister Modi attended the Global Peace Prayer Festival and offered prayers at the historic Tashichhodzong fortress in Thimphu, emphasizing the shared cultural and spiritual heritage.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Neighborhood First Policy**__

 __
 
• A core component of India's foreign policy that prioritizes building strong, mutually beneficial relations with its immediate neighbors to ensure a stable and prosperous South Asian region.
 
 
 
• **Punatsangchhu-II Hydroelectric Project**__
 __
 
• A significant 1,020 MW run-of-the-river power plant on the Punatsangchhu River, representing the largest joint energy venture between India and Bhutan aimed at sustainable energy production.
 
 
 
• **Tashichhodzong**__
 __
 
• A prominent Buddhist monastery and fortress in Thimphu that serves as the seat of the government of Bhutan and houses the throne room and offices of the King.
 
 
 
• **Tshering Tobgay**__
 
 
• The Prime Minister of Bhutan who hosted the visit. He has been instrumental in furthering the Indo-Bhutan strategic partnership and promoting the concept of Gross National Happiness.
